g1_1_business.what_it_does: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd is a travel technology company that provides AI-powered solutions for the hospitality industry. The company specializes in data analytics, distribution, and marketing technology, helping hotels, airlines, and online travel agencies optimize their pricing and marketing strategies. By leveraging advanced technology, RateGain enables its clients to enhance their operational efficiency and drive revenue growth.

customers.description: Includes hotels, airlines, and online travel agencies (OTAs) that utilize RateGain's technology for pricing and marketing.

manufacturing.description: RateGain develops its software solutions and technology infrastructure in India, leveraging local engineering talent.

competitive_advantage: Strong data network effects from processing vast amounts of travel data.
Long-term contracts with clients ensure stable revenue streams.
Unique position as India's only pure-play travel tech SaaS listed company.
Integration of AI technology enhances product offerings and customer value.
Established reputation and market presence in the travel technology sector.

drivers.title: Sojern Acquisition Integration
drivers.fact: The Sojern acquisition has added a new growth engine and is expected to contribute significantly to revenue.
drivers.why_it_matters: This integration is crucial for expanding RateGain's market share and enhancing its product offerings.
drivers.evidence_quote: Acquired Sojern (MarTech) in mid-FY26, adding a new growth engine.

drivers.title: Growth in Indian Travel Market
drivers.fact: India's travel market is projected to grow significantly, providing a favorable environment for RateGain.
drivers.why_it_matters: As the market expands, RateGain is well-positioned to capture a larger share of the growing demand.
